8.4.2.3 Bmc_Exchange
[SWS_Bmc_91025] Definition of API function Bmc_Exchange_u ⌈
Service Name
Bmc_Exchange_u
Syntax
Bmc_AtomicUType Bmc_Exchange_u (
volatile Bmc_AtomicUType* Object,
Bmc_AtomicUType Desired
)
Service ID [hex]
0x30
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
Desired
Value to be stored
Parameters (inout)
Object
Object
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Bmc_AtomicUType
The value pointed to by Object immediately before the effects
Description
Atomically replaces the value pointed to by Object with the value of Desired and returns the
value pointed to by Object immediately before the effects.
Available via
Bmc.h
⌋
